full_name: Long-Term Future Fund (EA Funds) — closed; succeeded by the Transformative AI Fund
mission: For years the main small-grants funder for independent AI safety researchers and new projects. Status: EA Funds closed the LTFF on 11 Aug 2026 after 820+ grants totalling just under $35M since 2017, and launched the Transformative AI Fund (TAIF) in its place, led full-time by Lowe Lundin. TAIF makes 'early-stage, fast, and tolerant of failure' grants, typically $10k–$150k, mainly to reduce catastrophic risks from advanced AI. Some former LTFF managers continue part-time via the AI Risk Mitigation Fund and Lightcone Commons.

warnings.text: The transition to advanced AI 'could be among the most important events in history, and it is not guaranteed to go well' (TAIF page).
Work to reduce catastrophic AI risk 'remains young and small relative to the stakes' (TAIF page).

recommendations.text: Provide fast, failure-tolerant early-stage funding — a first $25k can decide whether a pilot runs (TAIF page).
Fund training, field-building and new organisations, not only established groups.
